summary.root_cause_text: Deploy v1.6 (payments client HTTP library upgrade) fails to serialize Decimal amounts, so every payment call failed silently (DEBUG only) while orders were still marked processed.
recommended: Fix Decimal serialization in the v1.6 payments client before redeploying
Log payment provider failures at ERROR and alert on them

version: v1.6
payment_provider_url: internal://payments-v1
queue_max: 1000
worker_count: 1

Bad deploy v1.6 breaks payments. Roll back.
Rolled back version v1.6 -> v1.3. Confirmed: the service is now using the new value.
All business invariants green (health, payments, queue, worker, ledger, errors, latency).

root_causes: Deploy v1.6 (payments client HTTP library upgrade) fails to serialize Decimal amounts, so every payment call failed silently (DEBUG only) while orders were still marked processed.
evidence: DEBUG payment: provider call failed: Object of type Decimal is not JSON serializable (orders 18-35+)
recent_changes: v1.6 payments client: upgrade HTTP library, config reloaded v1.3 -> v1.6
args.impact: Orders processed without payment during v1.6 (10 at alert time, growing; unpaid money_impact at alert: SAR 1912.16, USD 663.64, total_sar 4400.81). Reprocess paid 26 orders, money_recovered total_sar 14247.39. No ledger corruption.
recommended_actions: Fix Decimal serialization in the v1.6 payments client before redeploying
Log payment provider failures at ERROR and alert on them
args.summary: Deploy v1.6 broke payment calls (Decimal not JSON serializable), logged only at DEBUG, so orders were processed with no payment while /health stayed green. I rolled back to v1.3 and reprocessed all unpaid orders. All invariants are now green.
